clips.title: The story
paras: In Dun Morogh, Felix Whindlebolt is missing the tools he carried from Gnomeregan. Frostmane trolls seized his bucket during his flight and took it to their camps.

Felix Whindlebolt lost his tools while fleeing Gnomeregan. After the disaster against the troggs, radiation drove thousands of gnomes into Dun Morogh's freezing wilds with whatever they could carry. Felix escaped with his equipment and headed for Anvilmar, but Frostmane trolls from the crags southwest of town ambushed him. They plundered his belongings, including his bucket of bolts and parts, leaving the artisan without the materials he needed for his craft in exile.
